abilities.name: filter
abilities.effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

abilities.name: technician
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

kanto.flavorText: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.

original-johto.flavorText: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.

hoenn.flavorText: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

original-unova.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

updated-unova.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

kalos.flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.

updated-alola.flavorText: It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don’t act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.

swsh.flavorText: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
